title: Suez Crisis
summary: Egypt nationalized the Suez Canal Company on about 26 July 1956. Israel invaded the Sinai on 29 October, and Britain and France bombed Egypt and landed troops near Port Said on 31 October. A UN ceasefire took effect on 7/8 November; a UN force arrived that month, and the Anglo-French withdrawal from Port Said was completed on 22 December 1956.

uncertainty.note: Start is nationalization (State Dept: July 26); end is completion of the Anglo-French withdrawal from Port Said.

where.historical_name: Port Said, at the Mediterranean end of the Suez Canal, Egypt

importance.justification: A major Cold War-era crisis that led to the first large UN emergency force.

audience_note: Concerns a military invasion with casualties.
